purpose_context: Felix's credential-liveness probe and its gog re-auth script were built when the Google OAuth app was in External+Testing mode, which forced a hard 7-day refresh-token expiry. The app is now published, so that expiry no longer applies. This mission removes the now-false '7-day routine' classification and its dead baseline machinery from the probe, and corrects the re-auth script's stale wording and consent-screen guidance, so future credential alerts are accurate and operators are not misdirected during re-auth.
purpose_tldr: Retire obsolete 7-day-Testing assumptions from Felix's Google-credential liveness monitoring now that the OAuth app is published.
